mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.password, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.nickname, u.gender, u.status, u.identity_verified AS identityVerified, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.keyword) AS CHAR) AS role, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.keyword) AS CHAR) AS permission FROM tb_jmz_user u LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.nickname, u.gender, u.status, u.identity_verified

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.nickname, u.gender, u.status, u.is_boosting_enabled AS isBoostingEnabled, u.identity_verified AS identityVerified, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.keyword) AS CHAR) AS role, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.keyword) AS CHAR) AS permission FROM tb_jmz_user u LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.nickname, u.gender, u.status, u.is_boosting_enabled, u.identity_verified
SELECT DISTINCT r.keyword FROM tb_jmz_user_role ur LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM tb_jmz_user_role ur LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.keyword FROM tb_jmz_user_role ur LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM tb_jmz_user_role ur LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_jmz_user WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_jmz_user) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_jmz_user WHERE TO_DAYS(create_time) = TO_DAYS(NOW())) AS todayNew

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM tb_jmz_user u INNER JOIN tb_jmz_user_game_boosting ug ON u.user_id = ug.user_id
u.is_boosting_enabled = 1
AND ug.game_id = #{gameId}
